description: Upgrade your home entertainment setup with this 30W mini home theater system designed for clear and powerful audio performance. Equipped with a 4-inch full-range driver, it delivers balanced sound with clear vocals and enhanced bass, making it ideal as a speaker home theatre, music system, or sound system for home use. This versatile home theatre speaker supports multiple connectivity options including Bluetooth for wireless streaming, USB for pendrive playback, FM radio (up to 108 MHz) for live stations, and AUX input for easy connection with TVs, laptops, desktops, and other devices. It works seamlessly as speakers for TV, making it a great choice for movies, music, and daily entertainment. The built-in RGB lights add a dynamic visual experience, creating an engaging atmosphere whether you're watching movies or hosting a small party. The included remote control allows convenient operation of volume, input modes, and lighting effects from anywhere in the room. Designed with a compact and modern look, this mini home theater fits easily into bedrooms, living rooms, and office spaces without occupying much space.
